name: App badge climb
oneLiner: a home screen of glossy app icons on a wallpaper lit in the brand colours wakes in a wave from the brand's own icon; the camera pushes in on it as its red badge pops on 1 and climbs faster and faster while the icon wiggles harder, then caps at 99+ with a hard bump, a ring breathing out and the rest of the screen dimming back
say: when the speaker says the notifications would not stop ('my phone would not stop buzzing', 'the messages kept coming', 'by lunch I had 99+'): cut in on the build-up, the badge climbs while they describe it and 99+ lands on the number or the punchline
